text: I withdraw this problem vote on re-review. The [class](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Monoid/Defs.lean#L65) correctly says that x ↦ a*x and x ↦ x*a are continuous for every fixed a: exactly separate continuity of multiplication. It does not assert joint continuity or require an addition operation. The docstring’s word “addition” is a copying error, as my original review observed; that wording does not make the mathematical definition incorrect.
